output.text: Dear {{buyer_name}} ji, this notice concerns invoice {{invoice_number}} for {{principal}}, which was due on {{due_date}}. Statutory interest of {{interest}} has accrued. A supplier may refer a delayed payment to the MSE Facilitation Council, and new claims are filed on the MSME ODR portal. A payment made after the due date can be deducted only in the year it is paid, and {{tax_bomb_days}} days remain until {{tax_bomb_date}}. We request payment at {{pay_link}}.
